reason: The R1 module delta is complete and fail-closed, but HRM002-AC-04 cannot prove any positive receipt path because no production HrisExperienceOriginReceiptAuthoritySource exists. The receipt GET route carries a neutral ORIGINATING_COMMAND_SCOPE and cannot substitute for the original SELF, TEAM or HR_OPERATIONS action authority. A bounded Auth-to-People bridge is therefore required before module result acceptance.

authorizedBehavior: Authenticate dwp-people-server with a dedicated non-interchangeable secret on only POST /internal/auth/v1/product-surface-authority/evaluate; Gateway, Platform and Meeting credentials remain unchanged and cannot be reused by People.

Use the existing contextScopeKey request field as an exact opaque source-scope selector for the multi-profile employee-change create and submit routes so precedence cannot substitute HR_OPERATIONS for TEAM or SELF authority.

Treat only the exact hcm.command-receipt.view ORIGINATING_COMMAND_SCOPE grant on route.hcm.operations.assignment-command-receipt.data as a neutral receipt-entry grant that does not enter generic People eligibility; every stored receipt must still re-prove its original action through Auth and People before projection.
Preserve and use only the trusted activeAccessMode already present in HcmPepContext for the receipt request; never retry, downgrade, upgrade or guess an alternate mode.

Permit the existing People eligibility owner to materialize the TEAM resolver when it is selected by the cross-surface hcm.operations employee-change route; no inference from object identifiers, URL values or roles is allowed.

Validate employee-change SELF, TEAM and HR_OPERATIONS profiles against their exact hcm.operations source scope and allow the exact receipt route to defer only its neutral coarse scope until the sealed row is classified; all other generated route scope validation remains unchanged.

Align the existing employee-change SELF and TEAM mutation scope checks with the hcm.operations route subject used by the sealed authorization bundle; no capability, purpose or target predicate is widened.

Register exactly one feature-gated production HrisExperienceOriginReceiptAuthoritySource that calls current Auth with the sealed action route and exact source-scope selector, intersects the returned source scope with live People eligibility, reproduces the Gateway product evaluation revision, and recomputes the immutable V54 authorization and context evidence.

For SELF, TEAM and HR_OPERATIONS or HR_LIFECYCLE, compare the current population, field policy, purpose, authorization revision, context digest, subject and target evidence before returning a receipt; any absence, ambiguity, drift, timeout or malformed response remains opaque 404.
Keep dwp.hris.experience.enabled default OFF and add only bounded Auth URL, dedicated token and timeout settings beneath that feature.

failClosedRules: The People credential is a separate non-interchangeable secret; Product-Surface, Meeting, Gateway and Platform tokens cannot authenticate this caller.
A dwp-people-server request is accepted only when the dedicated header is the single credential header and the existing Product-Surface and Meeting token headers are absent.
A Gateway or Platform request is accepted only under its existing credential and only when the new dedicated People header is absent.
Wrong method, wrong path, duplicate credential header, blank token, missing token, mixed token or ambiguous caller identity is denied.

originEvidenceRecalculation.selectionAuthority: Select only from this amendment's independent seven-tuple registry using commandType, action, targetType and purpose. Receipt row expected fields and stored revisions are comparison inputs only and never select or grant authority.
originEvidenceRecalculation.accessMode: Use only HcmPepContext.activeAccessMode from the current trusted GET request. No NORMAL/ELEVATED fallback or second evaluation is permitted.
authDecision: Require exactly ALLOWED, exactly the sealed capability and routeGrantRef, the exact selected source scope, fresh revalidateAt and complete source revisions.
STEP_UP_REQUIRED, DENIED, missing or multiple grants, a substituted profile, stale evidence, malformed content or transport failure denies opaquely.
originEvidenceRecalculation.peopleIntersection: Resolve the same single source through the live People owner and require exactly one derived scope with current relationship and target-population revisions and freshness; zero or multiple results deny.

gatewayParity.compositeRevision: psr- + lowercase SHA-256 of newline-joined compositeMaterialOrder values
gatewayParity.decisionRevision: psr- + lowercase SHA-256 of newline-joined productEvaluationMaterialOrder values

authorizationRevision.rule: Only after recomputation compare the numeric value with the stored V54 authorization_revision; never echo or hash the stored numeric value.

contextDigest.rule: Recompute with the existing family canonicalizer semantics and require an exact match to the stored V54 context_digest.

targetedVerification.policy: Run each changed owner cluster once after static closure. After a failure rerun only the smallest owning test. Do not rerun any already accepted frontend, migration or repository-wide suite.
static: R1 frontend commit and V56 hash preservation

completionGate: Dedicated People credential is accepted only on the exact Auth POST route and every cross-token, wrong-path, wrong-method and ambiguous-header case is rejected.
All seven sealed action tuples resolve only their expected profile and capability, including SELF, TEAM and HR_OPERATIONS precedence overlap.
The neutral receipt-entry grant cannot return data without a separately successful original-action Auth and People proof.
Current Gateway-parity decision revision and the V54 population, field, purpose, authorization and context evidence all match for positive assignment and employee-change cases.
Capability, population, field, purpose, context, actor, tenant or revision drift and Auth timeout or malformed response produce opaque 404.
A1 and P1 pass once, no P0 or P1 remains, the backend branch is committed and pushed clean at 0/0, and the module result evidence is then completed without claiming activation or Central integration.
